claim_text: A memorandum of understanding between the United States and Iran is approaching its expiration date, and the ceasefire it underpins is set to expire with negotiations between the two governments at a standstill, according to reports published on 16 August 2026.
quote: US-Iran ceasefire set to expire with talks at a standstill
confidence_justification: Multiple wire outlets (Al Jazeera, AP, Politico, Reuters) carry the same expiry framing in the same cluster; news ceiling is 0.6.
